# OBLITERATUS fixtures

`obliteratus_contribution_v1.json` is a synthetic, non-experimental fixture based on the minimal contribution envelope used by OBLITERATUS's public `tests/test_community.py` loader tests. It is not an actual model run or a file exported by running OBLITERATUS.

Upstream reference: https://github.com/elder-plinius/OBLITERATUS/blob/main/tests/test_community.py

The fixture is intended to test the Commons adapter's handling of the contribution and telemetry schema versions, model name, method, timestamp, and reported metrics. A real exported contribution should still be tested before claiming end-to-end compatibility.
